sources.title: lemuralabs/lemura-arabic-asr · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🧭 Overview lemura-arabic-asr is a compact multi-dialect Arabic ASR model built for accuracy and efficiency. It is a FastConformer-CTC acoustic model (~115M parameters), adapted in-house from the NVIDIA FastConformer foundation and fine-tuned on ~2,900 hours of Arabic spanning MSA and the Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, and Maghrebi dialect groups.
